findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_houses, list_rooms, get_room, list_offers, list_areas, get_area, get_faq, get_topic, list_events, search_site, check_availability · Private data: hotel_info, list_houses, get_topic · Public sink: list_offers, check_availability, request_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_houses, list_rooms, get_room, list_offers, list_areas, get_area, get_faq, get_topic, list_events, search_site, check_availability · Private data: hotel_info, list_houses, get_topic · Public sink: list_offers, check_availability, request_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
